status: G3 rest: processed, compressed and reviewed; in the game beyond the walls of Chapters II and VI at their Follow cameras (desktop build, High)
use: A rack of pila beside the drill ground, beyond the board: the second attempt, after g3-pilum-rack was rejected at review.

generator.prompt: A Roman army weapons rack of brown oak timber: a low trestle frame about two metres long with two cross rails, holding eight upright pila, heavy Roman javelins, each a long pale ash-wood shaft with a thin dark iron shank making up its upper part and ending in a small pyramidal point, with a squared iron collar where the shank meets the wood; a curved oval shield painted red leans against one end. Weathered brown wood and dark iron. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

review.scope: Tripo's own render, four views of the final compressed model with a 1.8 m figure for scale (scripts/assets/preview-model.mjs), and the camps in the desktop build at High
review.notes: An oak trestle rack of seven pila, ash shafts with dark iron heads and squared collars, and a red oval shield with a boss leaning on one end; turned 270° so it stands broadside to the camp. The heads came out leaf-shaped rather than pyramidal, and one is pale; both are small at the camera's distance. The first attempt, g3-pilum-rack, was rejected.
